Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join: molecule_dictionary parent to molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno, molecule_hierarchy to molecule_dictionary child on molregno, child to compound_structures on molregno, child to compound_records on molregno, compound_records to docs on doc_id, compound_records to activities on record_id, activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter: parent chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1336', target chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL279', standard_type equals 'IC50', standard_units equals 'nM'. Sort: compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Limit: None.
